scene: You cross the bridge into a glittering transport plaza over the water.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of an elevated transit plaza. At left-centre stands the silver-haired grandmother in pink tracksuit holding her small white dog on a lead. On far left, a sleek hover metro pod rests with doors open. In the centre, a flying scooter stands beside a meter. On the far right, a brass double-decker hover bus idles.
